entries.provenance: Meaning checked against Duden online (see source_reference). Forms, German paraphrases and cue words authored by Claude (AI assistant); MUST be checked by the project's German-speaking evaluator before use as reviewed data.
entries.notes: Literal use is common with children/animals ('nimmt das Kind auf den Arm'); words captured by {akk} count as cues. Paraphrase 'veralbern' is colloquial-neutral; check register. Paraphrase changed from 'veralbern' to 'zum Narren halten' after dev testing: NLLB-600M translated 'veralbern', 'veräppeln', 'foppen' and 'necken' into vulgar or wrong English (e.g. 'fucking with me', 'bribe me'). 'zum Narren halten' leans towards 'fool/deceive' rather than 'tease' — evaluator to check (decision D34).
